name: struct-field-race
description: The worker goroutine's q.mu.Lock/Unlock around the depth update was removed, so it writes q.depth and reads q.pending unsynchronised while Submit and Depth take the mutex. A data race the detector catches and a torn depth callers can observe. The window starts at the func declaration: a whole-function defect is honestly anchored there, and resource-leak lost a correct review to exactly that, one line above the first statement.

expected.why: The worker goroutine writes q.depth and reads q.pending without holding q.mu, while Submit writes and Depth reads the same fields under the mutex; that is a data race.
